No tocar backend/database/migrations/20260910_coa_cfdi_emitidos.sql ni su rollback. Evidencia: el commit 4a4468af772c22b939b61755bbc3d183c64f7e9d si incluyo el trigger CFDI, pero el workflow resolvia el tipo de migracion con git diff-tree sobre actions/checkout shallow y creaba evidence/ despues de esa resolucion; por tanto un fallo temprano podia dejar cero artifact. Mantener preflight HRLectura, verificacion EDARSAHUB/HRLectura y permisos DDL, migracion transaccional, postcheck, rollback automatico y artifact always. No tocar Produccion. No certificar ejecucion fisica en este Worker job: solo integrar recovery y trigger R2; la certificacion fisica requiere revisar run, steps y artifact posteriores.

actions.new:
- name: Resolve canonical migration contract
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p evidence
          BEFORE='${{ github.event.before }}'
          HEAD='${{ github.sha }}'
          {
            echo "before=${BEFORE}"
            echo "head=${HEAD}"
          } | tee evidence/trigger-resolution.txt
          if [ -n "${BEFORE}" ] && [ "${BEFORE}" != '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' ]; then
            CHANGED="$(git diff --name-only "${BEFORE}" "${HEAD}")"
          else
            CHANGED="$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "${HEAD}")"
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "${CHANGED}" | tee -a evidence/trigger-resolution.txt
          if echo "${CHANGED}" | grep -qx 'ops/migrations/requests/COA-CFDI-EMITIDOS-20260910.execute'; then
